By Nicole HerringtonJune 6, 2026

The Tony Awards are Sunday night. How well do you know this season’s shows and stars?

Several stars of “The Gilded Age” appeared on Broadway this season. Which one of these “Gilded Age” actors did not?

Ben Ahlers

Carrie Coon

Audra McDonald

Kelli O’Hara

Which two former “Saturday Night Live” cast members received Tony nominations for their performances?

Rachel Dratch and Ana Gasteyer

Ana Gasteyer and Maya Rudolph

Maya Rudolph and Rachel Dratch

Cecily Strong and Maya Rudolph

Several musicals, including “The Lost Boys,” were inspired by movies. Which of these shows took inspiration from a TV series?

“The Queen of Versailles”

“Schmigadoon!”

“Titaníque”

“Two Strangers (Carry a Cake Across New York)”

John Lithgow, who is playing Roald Dahl in “Giant,” and Nathan Lane, who is portraying Willy Loman in “Death of a Salesman,” are Broadway veterans who have been nominated for numerous Tony Awards. How many Tonys have they won, combined?

3

5

7

9

In “Dog Day Afternoon,” the actors Jon Bernthal and Ebon Moss-Bachrach attempt to rob a Brooklyn bank. On what TV series do they star as struggling Chicago chefs?

“The Bear”

“Hacks”

“The Gilded Age”

“The Pitt”

Increasingly, celebrities are joining the producing teams of plays and musicals, including Kim Kardashian, who is a co-producer of “The Fear of 13.” Who did not co-produce a Broadway show this season?

Kandi Burruss

George Clooney

Michelle and Barack Obama

Bowen Yang

June Squibb, 96, who starred in “Marjorie Prime,” made history by becoming the oldest actor to receive a Tony nomination. In what show did she make her Broadway debut?

“Chicago”

“Gorey Stories”

“Gypsy”

“Marjorie Prime”
